people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘Yahweh, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—
translations.bsb: So when I came to the spring today, I prayed: O LORD, God of my master Abraham, if only You would make my journey a success!
translations.kjv: And I came this day unto the well, and said, O LORD God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go:
translations.asv: And I came this day unto the fountain, and said, O Jehovah, the God of my master Abraham, if now thou do prosper my way which I go.
